scripts.types: pnpm run --silent types:emit > src/api/types.ts.tmp && mv src/api/types.ts.tmp src/api/types.ts || { rm -f src/api/types.ts.tmp; exit 1; }
scripts.types:check: pnpm run --silent types:emit | diff -u src/api/types.ts - || { echo 'src/api/types.ts is stale: run pnpm run types' >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.types:emit: json2ts -i src/api/protocol.schema.json --no-additionalProperties --unreachableDefinitions --style.printWidth=80 --style.trailingComma=all --bannerComment='/* eslint-disable */ /* Do not edit: generated by pnpm run types from protocol.schema.json, which EFFERENCE_WRITE_SCHEMAS=1 cargo test schema writes from the Rust types. */'
scripts.check: pnpm run types:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run test
